postconditions.expression: all(row_xor(grid, i) == target_xor for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: XOR of all elements in the i-th row is the same for each row

postconditions.expression: all(col_xor(grid, j) == target_xor for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: XOR of all elements in the j-th column is the same for each column

postconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] in range(n*n) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to (n^2 - 1) inclusive appear in the matrix exactly once
